newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tabacalera says no plans to up Midesa stake.
newsitem.headline: Tabacalera says no plans to up Midesa stake.

text.p: Spain's Tabacalera has no plans to increase its stake in newspaper distribution firm Marco Iberica Distribucion de Ediciones (Midesa), a spokesman for the tobacco firm said on Wednesday.
Tabacalera bought a 24.9 percent stake in Midesa for 3.67 billion pesetas in January.

"Tabacalera has no intention of launching a bid for Midesa. Nor does it intend to increase its stake, which would oblige it to make a public offer. We're very comfortable with what we have," the spokesman told Reuters.
There had been some market speculation of an increased stake or a buyout by Tabacalera, dealers said.
